purpose: Measures whether the ON-DEMAND case-based explanation retrieves clinically coherent neighbours: same-label neighbour rate (retrieval sanity) and same-vs-nearest-other-label similarity gap (boundary separation), over a frozen TRAIN-only DermLIP image bank.
faithful_by_construction_note: The neighbours ARE the query's nearest points in the frozen feature space the perception reader itself reads, so the explanation is faithful by construction (identity in the model's representation), not a post-hoc rationalisation. This eval does NOT test faithfulness (which is definitional); it tests whether that faithful retrieval is clinically SANE.

retrieval_feature_space.space: dermlip (512-d frozen DermLIP image embedding; image-only cosine)
retrieval_feature_space.argued_deviation_from_brief: The brief specified dermlip+metadata for the bank. Same verified premise failure as knn_ensemble_p2.json: in RAW cosine the 14-d one-hot metadata block swamps the unit-norm image block, so a metadata-concatenated bank retrieves by demographics, not lesion appearance. A linear probe reweights each dimension and is immune; cosine kNN is not. Image-only retrieval is the faithful and stronger choice.

bank.name: diagnosis@dermlip
bank.retrieval: exact cosine (unit-normalised dot product); no ANN, no randomness
bank.feature_space: dermlip (512-d frozen DermLIP image embedding; image-only cosine)

leak_discipline.primary_read: VALID queries vs TRAIN bank (disjoint splits -> leak-free by construction)

same_label_neighbor_rate.definition: fraction of the k nearest TRAIN cases whose CONFIRMED diagnosis matches the query's true diagnosis

boundary_separation_gap.definition: per-case (nearest-same-label cosine) minus (nearest-different-label cosine); positive => the case is closer to its own class than to any other
boundary_separation_gap.identity_note: fraction_cases_positive_gap equals one_nn_same_label_accuracy by construction (the gap is positive iff the single nearest case is same-label). The nearest_*_sim_mean pair shows the absolute proximities: both are high, so lesions sit in a DENSE region and near class boundaries in raw DermLIP cosine space -- which is precisely why surfacing the nearest different-label case is clinically informative (it flags a genuinely close rival, not a far-away strawman). The linear probe reweights dimensions to separate the classes; raw cosine kNN cannot (cf. knn_ensemble_p2.json).
